column1: # CodonPipe virulence discovery - species-specific acquired virulence loci
# WHAT THIS TABLE IS
# Some clinically important species are covered poorly by the pan-bacterial
# curated databases that evidence layers E1-E2 draw on, because their defining
# virulence determinants are ACQUIRED LOCI carried on mobile elements rather
# than individually characterised proteins of a reference proteome. For
# Klebsiella pneumoniae HS11286 (GCF_000240185.1), for example, the RefSeq
# annotation assigns no gene symbols at all - every 'gene' field repeats the
# locus tag - so symbol-based matching cannot work and the product name is the
# only annotation signal available.
# This table encodes such loci as explicit, citable definitions: the
# constituent gene symbols, regular expressions that match the RefSeq product
# names those genes actually carry, and how many distinct matching genes must
# be found, co-located on one replicon, before the locus is called present.
# codonpipe.virulence.species_loci applies it through the existing identifier
# crosswalk (GeneTable.lookup) and the existing operon/island machinery
# (codonpipe.virulence.context.extend_by_context).
# WHAT THIS IS NOT
# The Klebsiella rows reproduce the LOCUS DEFINITIONS and the VIRULENCE-SCORE
# RULE published for Kleborate (Lam et al. 2021, Nat Commun 12:4188). They are
# applied here by ANNOTATION MATCHING ONLY. This is not the Kleborate program
# and is not equivalent to running it:
#   * no sequence-identity or coverage scoring against the Kleborate allele
#     databases, so no ybST / cbST / AbST / SmST lineage assignment;
#   * no MLST;
#   * no Kaptive K-locus or O-locus typing;
#   * no minimap2, mash or BLAST dependency of any kind;
#   * a locus is called from the presence of annotated genes, so a genome whose
#     annotation is sparse, or which carries a pseudogenised or truncated
#     locus, can be called differently from how Kleborate would call it.
# Scores produced from this table must therefore be described as
# "Kleborate-style", never as Kleborate output.
# COLUMN DEFINITIONS
# scope_type            How scope_value is matched against the resolved target
#                       (codonpipe.virulence.resolve.TargetInfo):
#                         tax_id          exact TargetInfo.tax_id
#                         species_tax_id  TargetInfo.species_tax_id
#                         genus_tax_id    TargetInfo.genus_tax_id
#                         lineage_name    case-insensitive exact match against
#                                         any entry of TargetInfo.lineage_names
#                       A row whose scope does not match the target is never
#                       evaluated, so the layer is a strict no-op outside the
#                       configured scopes.
# scope_value           The taxid or lineage name to match.
# locus                 Short locus key, unique within one scope.
# locus_label           Human-readable name used in reports.
# score_scheme          Name of the scoring rule that consumes this locus; see
#                       SCORE_SCHEMES in species_loci.py. Empty = the locus is
#                       detected and reported but feeds no score.
# score_token           Token this locus contributes to that scoring rule.
# counts_toward_score   1 = presence of this locus changes the score;
#                       0 = detected and reported, but does not change it.
# gene_symbols          Comma-separated constituent gene symbols, matched
#                       through GeneTable.lookup and against the 'gene' field.
#                       Useful for genomes that do carry gene symbols; inert
#                       for genomes that do not.
# product_patterns      Python regular expression, applied with re.search to
#                       the RefSeq product name. Several alternatives are
#                       separated by '|' in the usual way.
#                       CASE SENSITIVITY IS DELIBERATE AND LOAD-BEARING.
#                       Patterns are compiled WITHOUT re.IGNORECASE when
#                       case_sensitive = 1, and sub-expressions that should
#                       ignore case are wrapped in Python's scoped inline flag
#                       (?i:...). The reason: the salmochelin receptor gene
#                       iroN matched case-insensitively as \biro[BCDEN]\b also
#                       matches the ordinary English word "iron", which occurs
#                       in dozens of unrelated iron-transport product names and
#                       would fabricate a salmochelin locus in almost any
#                       genome. Written case-sensitively as \b[Ii]ro[BCDEN]\b
#                       it matches IroE/iroB/iroN and not "iron".
# case_sensitive        1 = compile product_patterns case-sensitively (default,
#                       recommended); 0 = add re.IGNORECASE to the whole
#                       pattern.
# expected_gene_count   Number of genes in the complete published locus. Used
#                       as the denominator of the reported annotation
#                       completeness, nothing else.
# min_markers           Minimum number of DISTINCT genes matching this locus,
#                       co-located on one replicon, required to call the locus
#                       present. This is the guard against single spurious
#                       annotation hits: HS11286 carries one gene annotated
#                       "esterase_lipase family protein IroE" with no other iro
#                       gene anywhere, and min_markers = 3 correctly declines to
#                       call salmochelin from it.
# max_gene_gap          Maximum number of intervening genes tolerated between
#                       consecutive marker genes of one cluster.
# extend_locus          1 = recruit the remaining members of an accepted
#                       cluster through context.extend_by_context, so that
#                       locus genes whose RefSeq product name is generic
#                       (HS11286 annotates ybtX as "MFS superfamily transporter
#                       signal transducer" and ybtA as "AraC-type
#                       transcriptional regulator") are not lost. Recruitment
#                       is clamped to the span of the accepted cluster.
# machinery             Machinery class, using the vocabulary of
#                       virulence_vocabulary.tsv (dedicated / dual_use /
#                       regulatory / unclassified). Siderophore loci are
#                       dual_use: iron piracy operates in the host but also in
#                       iron-poor environments outside it. Colibactin is a
#                       DNA-alkylating genotoxin with no known function outside
#                       a eukaryotic host, so dedicated. The rmp capsule
#                       up-regulators are dual_use: capsule serves
#                       immune evasion and also desiccation and phage defence.
# axis_hint             host_interaction or virulence_general; feeds the
#                       host-interaction axis used by the strict tier.
# weight                Evidence-score contribution of a marker gene of this
#                       locus. Recruited (non-marker) locus members receive
#                       ScoringParams.w_species_locus_context instead.
# reference             Publication defining the locus and its membership.
# note                  Free text.
# A second, related trap: 'mucoid phenotype' also appears in the product name
# of rmpA2 ('mucoid phenotype regulator RmpA2'), which is a separate locus row.
# The rmpADC pattern therefore carries the negative lookahead
# (?!.{0,40}[Rr]mpA2) on that alternative, so that rmpA2 is counted once, under
# its own locus, instead of also inflating the rmpADC call.
# REFERENCES
# Lam MMC, Wick RR, Watts SC, Cerdeira LT, Wyres KL, Holt KE (2021) A genomic
#   surveillance framework and genotyping tool for Klebsiella pneumoniae and
#   its related species complex. Nat Commun 12:4188.
# Lam MMC, Wick RR, Wyres KL, Gorrie CL, Judd LM, Jenney AWJ, Brisse S,
#   Holt KE (2018) Genetic diversity, mobilisation and spread of the
#   yersiniabactin-encoding mobile element ICEKp in Klebsiella pneumoniae
#   populations. Microb Genom 4:e000196.
# Lam MMC, Wyres KL, Judd LM, Wick RR, Jenney A, Brisse S, Holt KE (2018)
#   Tracking key virulence loci encoding aerobactin and salmochelin
#   siderophore synthesis in Klebsiella pneumoniae. Genome Med 10:77.
# Walker KA, Miner TA, Palacios M, Trzilova D, Frederick DR, Broberg CA,
#   Sepulveda VE, Quinn JD, Miller VL (2019) A Klebsiella pneumoniae
#   regulatory mutant has reduced capsule expression but retains
#   hypermucoviscosity. mBio 10:e00089-19.

column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188
column19: Chromosomal, carried on the ICEKp integrative conjugative element. irp1/irp2 are annotated HMWP1/HMWP2 and irp9 as salicylate synthase in many RefSeq records.

column1: genus_tax_id
column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188
column19: DNA-alkylating genotoxin; no known function outside a eukaryotic host, hence dedicated rather than dual_use.

column1: genus_tax_id
column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188
column19: Usually plasmid-borne (pLVPK-like); the strongest single predictor of the hypervirulent phenotype and weighted three points in the published score.

column1: genus_tax_id
column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188
column19: Detected and reported but deliberately NOT scored: Lam et al. exclude iro from the score because its presence is very strongly associated with aerobactin. Pattern is case-sensitive so that iroN does not match the word 'iron'.

column1: genus_tax_id
column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188; Walker KA et al. (2019) mBio 10:e00089-19
column19: min_markers = 1 because rmpA has a highly specific product name ('regulator of mucoid phenotype A') while rmpD and rmpC are frequently annotated as hypothetical proteins. Not scored, per Lam et al.

column1: genus_tax_id
column18: Lam MMC et al. (2021) Nat Commun 12:4188
column19: A single-gene paralogue of rmpA on the virulence plasmid, frequently truncated by frameshift. Annotation matching cannot see a frameshift, so a call here means 'an rmpA2-annotated gene is present', not 'a functional rmpA2 is present'. Not scored.
